passages.title: Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing
passages.heading: Additions
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-47
passages.text: For rides with luggage for a trade fair, 23 EUR per ride is added to the standard taxi allowance. Questions about the taxi allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions. The travel office publishes worked examples of the taxi allowance on the intranet.

passages.title: Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing
passages.heading: Standard taxi allowance
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-02-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-38
passages.text: A single taxi or ride-hailing trip on business was reimbursed up to 45 EUR. Claims for the taxi allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing'. Questions about the taxi allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.title: Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing
passages.heading: Standard taxi allowance
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-47
passages.text: A single taxi or ride-hailing trip on business is reimbursed up to 42 EUR. Questions about the taxi allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions. Managers confirm claims for the taxi allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.title: Policy FAQ: travel and expenses
passages.heading: Current taxi allowance
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard taxi allowance? A: 42 EUR per ride, as set in HB-38 §2 (effective 2026-03-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-01.

passages.title: Memo: taxi allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Exception for rides between 22:00 and 06:00
passages.text: For rides between 22:00 and 06:00, the taxi allowance is 70 EUR per ride instead of the standard amount. Each claim for the taxi allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The travel office reviews the taxi allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.
